meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序编排多步任务,单阶段逐个执行,失败自动重试并续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一批互相依赖的任务,需要按先后顺序自动跑完。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a batch of tasks depend on each other and must run in order.

howto.what: 它把有依赖关系的任务定义成节点图,在 eval 单元里按波次执行:上游完成才跑下游,单个失败或跑偏的节点可用 retry、send、amend 单独修复。
howto.when: 当你要求 mass-ulw、给出任务 DAG,或存在必须等上游完成的分批任务时接管;完全独立的并行任务用普通并行派生即可。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这个改文档的任务拆成有依赖的 DAG 并跑起来
say.note: 先读规划文档,再定义节点图并启动一个 run

say.text: 重试 run_stub_1 里失败的 lint 节点
say.note: 只给该节点一次新尝试,已完成节点复用缓存

say.text: 给正在跑的 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 消息直接投递给该节点的子任务

howto.what_en: It defines dependency-ordered tasks as a node graph run inside an eval cell: downstream nodes wait for upstream ones, and a failed or drifting node can be fixed alone with retry, send, or amend.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for mass-ulw, supply a task DAG, or have staged work that must wait on upstream nodes; fully independent parallel tasks do not need it.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to split this docs task into a dependency-ordered DAG and run it
say_en.note: It reads planning.md first, defines the nodes, then starts one run

say_en.text: Retry the failed lint node in run_stub_1
say_en.note: Only that node gets a fresh attempt; finished nodes reuse cached results

say_en.text: Send a message to the running lint node: skip the vendored dir
say_en.note: The message goes to that node's child
